title: Exploring the Gothic District
text: Really nice way to explore the Gothic district of Barcelona.  One thing of note--you should use a earbud/headphone due to the street noise.
author: Bill_R

title: A fun and interesting walk
text:
I've never been to Barcelona before, so I was a bit concerned that I'd get lost in the labyrinth of the old town centre, but this tour is crystal clear with its directions. It doesn't just take you to the main tourist traps, but off the beaten track (just a little bit) to look at a variety of attractions.

From street art, markets, Gaudí architecture, and historical sites - to the oldest restaurant and cafe in Barcelona.

I loved the fact that it wasn't a dry history lesson, or detailed description of the methods a building was created, but a light-hearted walk with funny stories, interesting
author: K8776LUjohnh

title: Great option
text: It was nice to be able to go at our own pace and not be in a huge crowd. I was impressed with the directions and how the tour guide kept pace with our walking. Would definitely do again
author: Marie_V

title: Great tour
text: A really enjoyable walking tour discovering areas that we wouldn’t have found otherwise. Very entertaining, our family of three all enjoyed it. Especially being able to stop and pause where we wanted to.
author: Carey_G

title: Great experience
text:
We really enjoyed the audio tour, having the opportunity to make stops as we liked was very relaxing and fun.
The audio is clear and very easy to follow through the city.
Very recommended!!
author: Chrystell_E

title: Do it!
text: Very insighting and enjoyable! Highly recommend! Learnt a lot from this audio tour and really brought the area to life.
author: taeyoh

title: Best tour of our trip
text: I booked several experiences for our trip and found this to be the one we enjoyed the most.  The program was easy to install, easy to fallow, and extremely informative and interesting.  I wish I had downloaded it for every place we visited but we didn't use it until the end of our trip.  I will definitely be using this again.
author: TRACY_C

title: Funny Guide and Easy to Follow
text: After a lot of face-to-face guides, the audio guide was a welcomed relief. He is very engaging, and we all learned a lot! Also, it was really easy to follow his directions.
author: 331oraziob

title: A great tour for a BCN first-timer
text:
Very enjoyable, with some lighthearted bits, serious bits, and informative bits.  It's a good city hike too which I enjoyed.  I really like the idea of suggesting places to stop for food or drink on the way and just pausing the tour for a break.

It visits all the attractions you'd expect in the Gothic Quarter plus a few I'd never heard of before, with some good stories along the way.  

I don't know my way around Barcelona at all, so having all the directions included in the narration is great.   

I get why people love this place so much.
author: Lucas C

title: Deceptive ‘free’ tour
text: Guide was very good and informative.  Unfortunately it was made very clear at the beginning that this was not a free tour as advertised - we were EXPECTED to pay at least 20 € each at the end
